title: Mapping telescope of an exhaustive module-complex filtration
statement: For a commutative ring R, a cochain complex L of R-modules, complexes F_n, monomorphisms i_n:F_n→L and maps s_n:F_n→F_{n+1} with s_n followed by i_{n+1} equal to i_n, suppose every element in every degree of L comes from some F_n. In the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] there is an object S and a colimit cofan exhibiting S as the coproduct of the Q(F_n), indexed by ULift ℕ in the module universe, and maps making S→S→Q(L)→S[1] a distinguished triangle.

proof.text: Form the termwise sum S_0 of F_n, its shift map induced by s_n, and p:S_0→L induced by i_n. The sequence 0→S_0 --(1-shift)→S_0 --p→L→0 is degreewise exact. Injectivity follows recursively from the component at zero. Exhaustion gives surjectivity. A finite tuple in ker p is congruent modulo im(1-shift) to one component at a common later filtration stage; monicity of that stage inclusion makes this component zero.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] to the short exact sequence. Use [lem-pc-derived-module-direct-sums] to identify Q(S_0) with a derived coproduct; reindex along ULift ℕ≃ℕ.
